children: According to ChainCatcher citing Liquid247.xyz, a buy order for about 87.52 BTC, worth approximately $5.696 million, was posted on Hyperliquid’s BTC perpetual market at $65,078, about 0.00% below the midpoint of approximately $65,079 at the time. Near-term bids on the exchange totaled about $11.519 million, compared with $1.5328 million in asks. Bids exceeded asks by approximately $9.9871 million, accounting for 76.51% of total depth.

title: Hyperliquid BTC Perpetual Shows $5.696M Bid at $65,078
